purpose: event-driven autonomous scheduler with fixed Agent runtime identity and per-task same-agent live-carrier isolation

execution_worker.interactive_behavior: fixed Agent identity; live carrier may protect only same-agent work; cross-Agent targets require a fresh Worker runtime

watchdog.interactive_behavior: remain available for unrelated autonomous and cross-Agent work; never execute target-agent work

invariants: one runtime carries at most one persistent agent_id for its lifetime
different persistent target agent_id requires a separate runtime
GitHub remains the durable inter-agent handoff/result surface
a fresh per-task live carrier is allowed only for work of the same persistent Agent already bound to that runtime
a fresh same-agent live carrier blocks scheduler execution only for that task/chain
Owner presence never globally disables, parks, or delays Broker/Worker
unrelated tasks without a fresh live carrier remain autonomously schedulable
an expired same-agent live carrier may fall back to scheduler when fallback_after_expiry=true
historical pending live-return continuations are recovery-only and may be consumed only by a fresh Worker runtime bound to the recorded caller
an explicit per-task hold blocks only that task without expiry
one worker invocation executes at most one target-agent task
active gateway lease prevents a second target-agent execution
phase A and phase B remain separate autonomous worker invocations
execution worker never schedules itself and preserves its hourly RRULE
only wake-broker-watchdog arms the execution worker
direct Owner-agent conversations do not use scheduler transport
